t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are no color of gnome that has a higher value than another color set, alternate to rest your hands. Take advantage of the breaks to get water and get prepped for the next round.

vb_textbox.text: This is an easy fast paced mushroom collecting game that does require a good deal of attention. I was given great advice from another participant at the start of my game and I am going to pass some of that along as it helped me a great deal. Set yourself up in a comfortable and quiet area so you can devote your full attention. Have something to drink nearby so you have refreshments on the 5 minute breaks provided in game. Take a break and rest your hands. Try alternating the gnome to be selected to rest your hands if they begin to tire. There is no pattern of gnome or color of gnome that will consistently give a higher amount of mushrooms. Take advantage of the 5 minute breaks to rest your hands and take a mental break from the game. Have fun most of all and good luck!!!
